_comment: Curation file for the meditative soundtrack library.  Run:
It walks the recipes below, keeps only genuinely free-licensed audio
(CC0 / Public Domain / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA -- never -NC or -ND, because Reels
are public and sometimes monetised), rejects anything with vocals or that
is too short to cut a 45 s window from, normalises to 44.1 kHz stereo WAV
Add your own files by dropping them in music/incoming/ (provider 'local').
advancedsearch API and Wikimedia Commons MediaWiki API all respond.

recipes.name: pinned-verified
recipes.note: hand-checked CC0 recordings (licence read from each sound page)

pinned.why: tree-tone chimes over a soft drone, 2:05

recipes.name: tanpura-drone
recipes.note: real acoustic tanpura: the bed of every Mahabharata scene

recipes.name: bansuri-alap
recipes.note: Krishna's flute; slow alap phrasing, no rhythm section

recipes.name: temple-bells
recipes.note: long decays make ideal flash/bell exciters

recipes.name: field-ambience
recipes.note: battlefield-at-dawn air beds; layer under anything

recipes.name: cc-music-ambient
queries: collection:netlabels AND mediatype:audio AND format:MP3 AND (title:("ambient drone") OR title:("meditation music")) AND licenseurl:("http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/")
collection:netlabels AND mediatype:audio AND (title:(drone) OR subject:(drone)) AND licenseurl:("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")
collection:netlabels AND mediatype:audio AND (title:("new age") OR subject:("new age")) AND licenseurl:("http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/")
collection:(audio_music) AND mediatype:audio AND (title:("raga instrumental") OR title:("classical guitar instrumental")) AND licenseurl:("http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/")
recipes.note: netlabel albums: whole CC0/CC-BY instrumental releases, one file per track

recipes.name: commons-classical
recipes.note: encyclopedic PD/CC audio; license read from each file's extmetadata

recipes.name: local-incoming
recipes.note: anything you drop in music/incoming (keep a LICENSE.txt next to it)
